title: Prevent oversized validation inputs from exhausting memory
scope: Remove GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 from root and mockup sandbox installed and locked graphs by migrating Zod to a fixed version with compatible Drizzle, form resolver and error formatting adapters. Preserve schemas, nullable entry text and footage, string conductors, coercion, defaults, AI output parsing and safe malformed-input HTTP 400 contracts. Verify consumer-relative resolution and portable clean locked installs. No audit waivers, production-data changes or deployment.
why: Only test-heavy includes security-audit and browser-tests alongside typecheck and unit-tests required for this dependency compatibility repair.
coverage: docs/validation/manifest.json test-heavy has a 900000 ms bound; security-audit runs npm audit --audit-level=high, unit-tests includes dependency-tooling-security and routes tests, typecheck includes application and browser types, browser-tests uses scripts/run-browser-tests.mjs.

approval.reference: Assigned task 1007 in the active conversation
approval.direction: Prevent oversized validation inputs from exhausting memory and complete the specified compatibility and regression coverage
approval.applicability: Major Zod migration and related adapter updates are explicitly within the assigned scope; independent verification is not selected

assertions.check: Root and sandbox locked and actual consumer resolutions use Zod at least 4.6.6 and compatible adapters; portable clean installs retain those resolutions and the exact advisory is absent.
A timeout-bounded child with a heap limit rejects an oversized constrained collection deterministically without memory exhaustion; normal valid collections succeed.

Real API malformed inputs retain HTTP 400 and safe errors; nullable text and footage, string conductors, coercion and defaults remain accepted; form and AI schemas compile and existing browser entry footage flows pass.

regression.rationale: Material security and compatibility repair for memory exhaustion in constrained collection validation.
regression.covers: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 and migration regressions in collection bounds, schema defaults, nullability, coercion and error formatting
regression.assertion: Consumer-relative version guards detect vulnerable root or sandbox resolutions; a memory-limited bounded child verifies early rejection and ordinary success; API and browser cases preserve malformed-input 400 responses and valid nullable entry fields and string conductors.
